definitions.explanation: Based on immediate understanding without conscious reasoning; relying on intuition.

examples.japanese: {直感的|ちょっかんてき}に{分|わ}かった。
このアプリは{直感的|ちょっかんてき}な{操作|そうさ}ができる。
examples.english: This app has an intuitive interface.

examples.japanese: {直感的|ちょっかんてき}に{危険|きけん}を{感|かん}じた。

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
Formed from {直感|ちょっかん} (intuition) + 的 (suffix making na-adjectives).

ADVERBIAL FORM:
{直感的|ちょっかんてき}に: intuitively, instinctively

USAGE:
Commonly used in technology contexts to describe user-friendly interfaces.
